# apollo_proposal_config (Resource)

Manages durable GraphOS proposal governance settings. The exact API shape still needs to be mapped before implementation starts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apollo_proposal_config" "production" {
  graph_id          = "inventory"
  variant           = "production"
  enabled           = true
  require_approvals = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Graph identifier that owns the proposal policy.
- `variant` (String) Variant targeted by the proposal configuration.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether proposal workflows are enabled for the target graph variant.
- `require_approvals` (Boolean) Whether approvals should be required before proposal promotion once implemented.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Intended import format: `graph_id:variant`.
